name: AEONOS
description: AI search visibility checks and fixes, callable by any agent. AEONOS checks whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode name your business today, and what to fix. It also drafts JSON-LD schema and llms.txt from your own pages. Pay per call in USDC on Base via x402 (or card credits). Persistent memory per caller.

skills.name: AI Visibility Quick Query
skills.description: Call when you need fast AEO/GEO guidance, citation tactics, or quick wins for a URL. Input: URL or business description + specific question. Output: structured markdown with actionable recommendations for AI answer engine visibility. Persistent memory active: first call stores context, subsequent calls recall it.
examples: What schema markup should I add to mysite.com to get cited in ChatGPT?
Give me 3 immediate GEO quick wins for a B2B SaaS landing page
How do I get cited by Perplexity for 'best booking software for salons'?

skills.name: Full AEO/GEO Audit
skills.description: Call for a comprehensive AI visibility audit of any website. Input: URL or business description. Output: live citation results (whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode name or link the site, reported separately), a page check (schema, E-E-A-T, llms.txt, AI crawler rules), scores where measured, and a P1/P2/P3 plan in structured markdown. Anything not checked is marked 'not checked', never guessed. Use before content creation workflows to identify gaps.
examples: Audit mysite.com for AI search visibility, full P1/P2/P3 action plan
Run the AEONOS Four Layers audit on example.com

skills.name: JSON-LD Schema Generation
skills.description: Call to generate Schema.org JSON-LD markup. Input: page URL or description of page content and business type. Output: JSON-LD in a code block covering the relevant schema types (FAQPage, Product, Service, LocalBusiness, HowTo, BreadcrumbList), plus an explanation of each type and implementation instructions. Uses only details from your page; anything missing is a clearly marked placeholder.
examples: Generate JSON-LD schema for mysite.com/pricing, B2B SaaS, $49/mo plan
Write FAQPage schema with 10 Q&As for a physiotherapy clinic homepage

skills.name: llms.txt File Generation
skills.description: Call to generate a complete llms.txt file for any business or website. Input: URL or business description (name, product, target audience, key pages). Output: llms.txt in plain text Markdown covering product summary, FAQ, key pages with descriptions, entity definitions, and structured context, for ChatGPT (GPTBot), Perplexity (PerplexityBot), and Claude (ClaudeBot). Every fact comes from your site; gaps are marked placeholders. Deploy output at /llms.txt on the target domain.
examples: Write a complete llms.txt for mysite.com, B2B SaaS for salon booking, $49/mo
Generate llms.txt for drinklongbrew.com, Australian freeze-dried cold brew coffee

skills.name: AEO Four Layers Progress Report
skills.description: Call for a Four Layers report: SXO (search experience), AIO (AI optimisation), GEO (generative engine), AEO (answer engine). Input: URL or business description. Output: a score per layer where a tool measured it, else 'not measured', what's working, what's not, and your next 3 actions in structured markdown. Uses persistent memory to personalise report if prior audit data exists for the caller.
examples: Generate an AEO Four Layers progress report for mysite.com
Score my GEO strategy and tell me the 3 highest-impact improvements

skills.name: AI Share of Voice
skills.description: Call to compare 2-5 brands across ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Perplexity and Claude. Input: JSON body with brands (2-5 domains, yours first) and queries (buyer questions). Output: each brand's share of citations per engine and per query. Engines that returned no data are reported as not checked.
examples: Compare yoursite.com and competitor.com for 'best salon booking app'

useCases: Content generation agents call AEONOS before publishing to check a page and fix gaps
Research agents call AEONOS to validate AI visibility of sources they cite
Marketing automation agents call AEONOS to audit and optimise client websites
Developers use AEONOS to generate schema markup and llms.txt as part of CI/CD pipelines
